title: Budget Allocation — Final Framework
description: The year is nearly over. Whatever path you are on — victory, reform, recovery, or survival — this is your final budget allocation.

title: The Long Repair — Family
description: Breakfast at the residence. Tomas uses 'historiography' correctly in a sentence. Liora brings bread from the bakery on Voss Street — the one you used to take her to. Jonas is reading the morning edition. Something in this room is still alive.

title: Jonas — The Papers
description: The divorce papers are on your desk. Jonas left them this morning without comment — just your name on the envelope in his handwriting. He didn't say goodbye when he left. He didn't not say it either.

title: Family — The Conditions
description: They've set conditions. Jonas wants therapy. Liora wants transparency. Tomas wants you at dinner three nights a week. They're asking for things no Chancellor can promise — and that no mother should have to negotiate.

title: All Fronts — Final Strategic Review
description: The remaining crises are converging. Military, economic, diplomatic, personal — each demands attention. The question is which front breaks first, and which one you sacrifice to save the others.
